twistable.name: Twistable flexible waveguide
twistable.short: Bends and twists: connects misaligned or rotated flanges. WR-22 to WR-284.
twistable.description: Flexible, twistable brass waveguide made by Tecnolambro. It bends in the E and H planes and twists around its own axis: it connects radio and antenna when the flanges are misaligned or rotated, and absorbs vibration and thermal expansion.
applications: Correcting misalignment and rotation between flanges

seamless.name: Seamless flexible waveguide
seamless.short: No seams, CW power up to 10 kW. WR-22 to WR-284.
seamless.description: Seamless flexible waveguide, with no seams along the body, made by Tecnolambro. The table gives VSWR, attenuation and power for every size from WR-22 to WR-284.

bends.name: Bends
bends.short: E-plane and H-plane bends, 90° or at the angle you need.
bends.description: Rigid waveguide bends in the E-plane and H-plane, designed, built and tested in our laboratory. 90° in every size, or with custom angle, radius and straight legs.
applications: Custom angle, radius and straight legs

faqSection.title: Frequently asked questions
faqSection.body: Answers to the questions engineering and purchasing teams ask us most.

sizes.q: Which waveguide sizes do you make?
sizes.a: We make twistable and seamless flexible waveguide in 14 sizes, from WR-22 (33.0–50.1 GHz) to WR-284 (2.6–3.95 GHz): the data is in the technical tables. For your exact frequency use the frequency finder.

custom.q: Do you build parts to customer drawings?
custom.a: Yes. We design, build and test single parts and small batches from your drawing or a specification.

files.q: Which file formats can I send?
files.a: PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, IGES or STL, up to 20 MB per file, straight from the quote request. A dimensioned PDF with tolerances and finish is enough for a first offer; a 3D model helps with complex shapes.

leadTime.a: Material in stock ships within 48 hours. For custom and build-to-print parts we set the delivery time in the quote.

moq.q: Is there a minimum order quantity?
moq.a: [TO BE COMPLETED: minimum order quantities, if any] Give the quantity in your request: every quote is tailored.

shippingEu.q: Do you ship across the European Union?
shippingEu.a: Yes. We ship worldwide: method and cost are stated in the quote. [TO BE COMPLETED: courier]

shippingWorld.q: Do you ship outside the European Union?
shippingWorld.a: Yes, we work with customers worldwide: shipping method and cost are stated in the quote. Exports are zero-rated for Italian VAT. [TO BE COMPLETED: Incoterms, customs documents]

invoicing.q: How do you invoice an EU company with a VAT number?
invoicing.a: With a valid EU VAT number (checked in VIES) we invoice without Italian VAT: the customer accounts for the tax under the reverse-charge mechanism. Enter your VAT number in the quote form.

materials.q: Which materials and finishes do you use?
materials.a: The flexible waveguide is made of OT 80 UNI 4897 brass. Bright dipping, painting, heat and galvanic treatments are done with long-standing, selected suppliers. [TO BE COMPLETED: other finishes available]

testing.a: Yes: we test 100% of parts before shipping. [TO BE COMPLETED: parameters measured and documents supplied with the part]

flexTwist.q: What is the difference between twistable and seamless flexible waveguide?
flexTwist.a: Twistable waveguide bends in the E and H planes and twists around its own axis: use it when the two flanges are also rotated. Seamless waveguide has no seams along the body. VSWR, attenuation and power of both versions are in the technical tables. We make both.

shopVsQuote.a: No: every order starts from a quote request, because prices are tailored. Configure the part or pick a ready-made one, add quantity and notes and send the request: we reply within 24 hours.

drawing3d.a: Yes. From the configurator you can download the PDF drawing and the 3D model in STL and GLB straight away; we send the STEP file together with the quote.

clientDrawing.q: Do you work from customer drawings?
clientDrawing.a: Yes. Upload STEP, IGES, STL, PDF, DWG or DXF with your quote request: our engineering office reviews it and replies within 24 working hours.

hours.a: Monday to Friday, 8:00–12:00 and 13:30–17:30 (CET). Closed on Saturday and Sunday. Website requests are received outside office hours too.

For any privacy request: info@tecnolambro.it, certified email tecnolambrosnc@pec.it, phone +39 375 577 1084.
Data entered in the quote request: company, first and last name, email, phone (optional), country, VAT number (optional), requested parts with quantities and notes.
Files uploaded with the request (drawings and models in PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP, IGES or STL). Drawings may contain personal data, for example the designer’s name in the title block.
Browsing data: IP address and technical information logged by the server for security and operation. Aggregate, anonymous visit statistics without cookies (see section 7).
To answer the quote request and handle pre-contractual negotiations: legal basis Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps taken at the request of the data subject).
To comply with legal obligations, for example tax and accounting, if the request becomes an order: Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.
To keep the website secure and measure its use in aggregate form: legitimate interest of the controller, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
We do not use data for marketing without separate consent and we do not sell it to third parties.
Quote requests and attached files: for as long as needed to handle the request and up to 24 months after the last contact, unless they become an order.
Documents relating to orders and invoices: 10 years, as required by tax law.
Server technical logs: up to 12 months.

To exercise them, write to info@tecnolambro.it. We reply within 30 days.
You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority, Garante per la protezione dei dati personali (www.garanteprivacy.it), or with the authority of your EU country.
If enabled, we use Plausible Analytics, a cookie-free analytics service that collects no personal data and does not track users across sites. Data is aggregate and anonymous.
The website uses only technical browser storage (chosen theme, intro animation already seen). Details in the cookie policy.
We may update this notice. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

This website presents the products and services of Tecnolambro S.a.s. di Pasquini Marco & C. (VAT IT08639310153). Technical information is indicative: the binding characteristics, sizes and performance are those confirmed in the written offer.

We use them only to assess feasibility and prepare the quote and, if you order, to build the part. We do not share them with third parties, except with partners carrying out a manufacturing step on your behalf, bound by confidentiality.
On request we delete files not linked to an order. If you need a non-disclosure agreement (NDA), we sign it before you send the drawings.
Texts, technical drawings, graphics and the Tecnolambro brand are protected. They may not be copied or reused without written permission, except quoting with a link.
We take care that the content is accurate but cannot guarantee it is always complete or up to date. Before an order, the quote and the order confirmation prevail.
Drawings and 3D models generated by the configurator are indicative: the final drawing comes with the quote.
We may change these terms. The valid version is the one published on this page, with its update date.
Italian law applies. Questions: info@tecnolambro.it, +39 375 577 1084.

The website does not use profiling cookies or third-party advertising cookies. That is why we do not show a consent banner.

We store some technical information in your browser: the light or dark theme you chose and the “Your request” list with parts, quantities and notes (localStorage), and whether the intro animation has already played in this session (sessionStorage). It stays on your device until you send the request or clear it in your browser settings.
If enabled, Plausible Analytics counts visits in aggregate form without cookies and without persistent identifiers.
The parts list is cleared after sending. Data entered in the form reaches Tecnolambro only when you press “Send quote request”.
